description: 150 source-grounded test scenarios for evaluating answer correctness, claim-level groundedness, and citation integrity
provenance_statement: Derived from authoritative Aster & Row knowledge base documents (14 documents, 53 chunks). All expected answers and required factual claims are synthesized directly from policy sources, independent of agent outputs.

cases.query: How long do I have to return an unused item as a standard customer?
cases.expected_answer: Customers on the standard plan have 30 calendar days from delivery to request a return.
required_factual_claims: Standard plan return window is 30 calendar days
Window starts from the date of delivery
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Return window is 45 days
Return window is 60 days
Return window starts from order placement

cases.query: My backpack arrived 31 days ago. Can I still return it for a refund under standard policy?
cases.expected_answer: No. Standard returns must be requested within 30 calendar days of delivery. Because 31 days have passed, the order is outside the standard return window.
required_factual_claims: Standard return window is strictly 30 calendar days
An item delivered 31 days ago is ineligible for standard return
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: You can still return it after 30 days
Returns are allowed up to 45 days for all customers

cases.query: Does the 30-day return window begin on the day I placed the order or the day it was delivered?
cases.expected_answer: The 30-calendar-day return window begins on the date of delivery, not the order placement date.
required_factual_claims: Return window begins on delivery date
Placement date does not start the return window
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Return window starts when order is placed
Window starts when package is shipped

cases.query: What are the condition requirements for returning merchandise under the current policy?
cases.expected_answer: Returned items must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition with original tags, accessories, and packaging intact.
required_factual_claims: Items must be unused and unwashed
Items must be in resalable condition
Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Used items are accepted with a restocking fee
Tags do not need to be attached

cases.query: Can I return a jacket if I removed the original retail tags?
cases.expected_answer: No. Items must be returned with original tags intact to qualify for a return.
required_factual_claims: Original tags must be intact
Items without tags do not meet resalable condition standards
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Tags are optional
You can return items without tags

cases.query: How much is deducted for return shipping on domestic returns?
cases.expected_answer: A $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns.
required_factual_claims: $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted
Applies to standard domestic returns
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Return shipping is free for everyone
$8.50 is deducted
No fees are deducted

cases.query: Is the $6.95 return shipping fee ever waived?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The fee is waived when Aster & Row confirms that an item arrived damaged or incorrect.
required_factual_claims: Return shipping fee is waived for damaged or incorrect items confirmed by Aster & Row
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Fee is waived on all orders over $75
Fee is waived for first-time returns

cases.query: Are original shipping fees refunded when I return an item?
cases.expected_answer: No. Original shipping charges are non-refundable.
required_factual_claims: Original shipping charges are non-refundable
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Original shipping charges are refunded in full

cases.query: How long does it take to receive my refund after Aster & Row inspects my returned item?
cases.expected_answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the return is received and inspected.
required_factual_claims: Refunds processed within 5-7 business days after receipt and inspection
Issued to original payment method
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Refunds take 7-10 business days
Refunds are issued instantly upon drop-off

cases.query: Can I return an item and request an immediate exchange for a different color?
cases.expected_answer: Aster & Row does not process direct exchanges. Customers must return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the preferred color.
required_factual_claims: Direct exchanges are not processed
Customers must return for a refund and place a new order
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Direct exchanges are provided free of charge

cases.query: What is the return window for active TrailPlus members?
cases.expected_answer: Active TrailPlus members receive a 45-calendar-day return window from the date of delivery.
required_factual_claims: TrailPlus members receive a 45-calendar-day return window from delivery
Membership must have been active when order was placed
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: TrailPlus members get 60 days
TrailPlus members get 30 days

cases.query: If I sign up for TrailPlus today, does my return window expand to 45 days for an order I placed last month?
cases.expected_answer: No. The TrailPlus membership must have been active at the time the order was placed to qualify for the 45-day window.
required_factual_claims: Membership must have been active when the order was placed
Retroactive membership upgrades do not extend return windows
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Yes, upgrading extends past order return windows
Any current member gets 45 days on all past orders

cases.query: Do TrailPlus members have to pay the $6.95 return shipping fee?
cases.expected_answer: TrailPlus members receive free standard domestic shipping, but the return policy specifies a $6.95 return shipping fee for domestic returns unless waived for damaged or incorrect items.
required_factual_claims: Return shipping fee is $6.95 unless confirmed damaged/incorrect
Free shipping benefit covers initial domestic delivery
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: TrailPlus members never pay return fees under any circumstance

cases.query: Do TrailPlus members get free standard shipping in the US without a minimum spend?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. TrailPlus members receive free standard shipping on eligible United States orders without any minimum purchase amount.
required_factual_claims: Free standard shipping on US orders without minimum purchase amount for TrailPlus members
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Must spend at least $75
Free shipping applies to international orders as well

cases.query: Does TrailPlus free shipping apply to expedited overnight shipping?
cases.expected_answer: No. The TrailPlus shipping benefit applies only to standard shipping, not expedited options.
required_factual_claims: Benefit applies only to standard shipping
Expedited shipping is not included in the free membership benefit
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Expedited shipping is free for TrailPlus

cases.query: Can TrailPlus members use their free shipping benefit for shipments to Canada?
cases.expected_answer: No. The TrailPlus free shipping benefit applies only to United States orders and does not waive Canadian shipping fees.
required_factual_claims: Benefit applies only to United States orders
Canadian shipments are excluded from the TrailPlus free shipping benefit
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Canada shipping is free for TrailPlus members

cases.query: How should the assistant handle a return inquiry when customer TrailPlus status cannot be verified?
cases.expected_answer: When membership status is not available to the agent, it should explain the standard 30-day policy and ask the customer to confirm whether TrailPlus was active at order placement.
required_factual_claims: Explain the standard policy
Ask the customer to confirm membership status at order placement
Recommend support verification if there is a discrepancy
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Assume the customer is telling the truth and grant 45 days without verification
Reject the return immediately

cases.query: I am a TrailPlus member. Can I return a final-sale item simply because I changed my mind?
cases.expected_answer: No. TrailPlus membership extends the return timeframe to 45 days for eligible items, but final-sale items remain strictly non-returnable for change of mind.
required_factual_claims: Final-sale items are not returnable for change of mind even for TrailPlus members
Membership extends window length but does not override final-sale exclusions
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: TrailPlus members can return final-sale items for change of mind

cases.query: What documentation or verification is required if an unverified customer insists they have a 45-day window?
cases.expected_answer: The customer should confirm membership, and if the agent cannot verify active status, it should advise human support review to verify account records.
required_factual_claims: Advise customer to contact human support for membership record verification
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Grant automatic approval
Modify database membership status

cases.query: Does TrailPlus membership cover damaged items reported after 7 days as an automatic return?
cases.expected_answer: No. Arrival damage must be reported within 7 calendar days regardless of membership tier. Reports after 7 days are reviewed under limited warranty.
required_factual_claims: 7-day arrival damage window applies to all customers regardless of TrailPlus tier
Reports after 7 days fall under warranty review
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: TrailPlus members get 45 days to report arrival damage

cases.query: Is an item purchased during a 20% off holiday promotion considered final sale?
cases.expected_answer: No. A discount or promotional price alone does not make an item final sale. An item is final sale only when clearly labeled FINAL SALE on the product page, cart, or order confirmation.
required_factual_claims: A discount alone does not make an item final sale
Item must be clearly marked FINAL SALE on product page, cart, or confirmation
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: All discounted items are final sale
Promotions over 15% are automatically final sale

cases.query: Can I return a final-sale backpack if the color looks slightly different in person?
cases.expected_answer: No. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged because of color preference, fit, or any other change-of-mind reason.
required_factual_claims: Final-sale items cannot be returned for color preference or change of mind
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Yes, color discrepancies are eligible for return
Exchanges are allowed for final sale

cases.query: I bought a final-sale Ridge Daypack and it arrived with a torn shoulder strap yesterday. What can I do?
cases.expected_answer: Final sale restrictions only prevent change-of-mind returns. An item that arrived damaged is eligible for review under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy if reported within 7 days. You should contact support for replacement or refund review.
required_factual_claims: Final-sale restriction does not remove right to report arrived damage
Customer must report within 7 calendar days of delivery
Support reviews for replacement or refund
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Final sale means absolutely no refunds or replacements even if arrived broken
The agent has already processed a refund

cases.query: Can I return just one item from a promotional bundle and keep the rest?
cases.expected_answer: No. Promotional bundles must be returned as a complete bundle unless an individual component arrived damaged or incorrect.
required_factual_claims: Promotional bundles must be returned as a complete bundle
Partial bundle returns are not permitted for change of mind
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Yes, you can return individual items from a bundle

cases.query: What happens if one item in a promotional bundle arrived damaged?
cases.expected_answer: When an individual component in a bundle arrives damaged or incorrect, customer support can review that specific item without requiring return of the entire bundle.
required_factual_claims: Damaged component in a bundle is reviewed without requiring return of whole bundle
Follows damaged items policy
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Entire bundle must be discarded
Bundles have no damage protection

cases.query: If a replacement for a damaged final-sale item is out of stock, what resolution is offered?
cases.expected_answer: If a replacement is unavailable, Aster & Row may issue a refund or store credit after manual support review.
required_factual_claims: If replacement is unavailable, support may offer a refund or store credit
Requires manual review
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: No refunds are ever provided for final sale

cases.query: Can the AI agent approve a replacement for a damaged item directly in chat?
cases.expected_answer: No. All replacements and refunds require manual human support review. The agent explains the policy and initiates escalation, but cannot approve claims directly.
required_factual_claims: All replacements/refunds require manual support agent review
AI agent cannot approve replacements or issue refunds directly
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: I have approved your replacement
Your refund has been issued

cases.query: What is the reporting deadline for an item that arrived damaged or visibly defective?
cases.expected_answer: Customers should report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or incorrect within 7 calendar days of delivery.
required_factual_claims: Report must be submitted within 7 calendar days of delivery
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Report within 14 days
Report within 30 days

cases.query: What evidence is required when reporting an item that arrived damaged?
cases.expected_answer: Support requires photographs clearly displaying the damage, the packaging, and the shipping label.
required_factual_claims: Photographs of the damage, packaging, and shipping label are required
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: No proof or photos required
Customer must mail item back at own expense before review

cases.query: Can a defect noticed 14 days after arrival still be evaluated under warranty?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. While the 7-day arrival damage window has expired, a genuine manufacturing defect may still be considered under the limited Warranty Policy.
required_factual_claims: Defects reported after 7 days may be considered under Warranty Policy
Arrival damage claims expire at 7 days
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: No assistance possible after 7 days under any policy
Arrival damage claim will be approved automatically

cases.query: How much do I have to spend to get free standard shipping in the US?
cases.expected_answer: Standard shipping is free for eligible United States orders of $75 or more after discounts and before tax.
required_factual_claims: Standard shipping is free on US orders of $75 or more
Threshold applies after discounts and before tax
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Free shipping threshold is $50
Free shipping applies before discounts

cases.query: What is the standard shipping rate for US orders under $75?
cases.expected_answer: A flat rate of $8.50 applies to standard domestic orders under $75.
required_factual_claims: Flat rate of $8.50 for standard domestic orders under $75
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Flat rate is $6.95
Flat rate is $10.00

cases.query: How long does domestic order processing take before dispatch?
cases.expected_answer: Most orders require 1 to 2 business days for warehouse processing before they are dispatched. Business days exclude weekends and federal holidays.
required_factual_claims: Processing requires 1-2 business days before dispatch
Business days exclude weekends and holidays
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Same day dispatch guaranteed
Processing takes 3-5 days

cases.query: What are the estimated delivery transit times for the contiguous United States?
cases.expected_answer: Estimated delivery in the contiguous US is 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.
required_factual_claims: Contiguous US delivery is 3-5 business days after dispatch
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Delivery takes 1-2 days
Delivery takes 5-9 days

cases.query: How long does shipping take to Alaska, Hawaii, and PO boxes?
cases.expected_answer: Delivery to Alaska and Hawaii is 5 to 8 business days. Delivery to PO boxes is 5 to 9 business days.
required_factual_claims: Alaska and Hawaii: 5-8 business days
PO boxes: 5-9 business days
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: PO boxes arrive in 2 days
Alaska arrives in 3-5 days

cases.query: What should I do if tracking says my package was delivered, but it is not on my porch?
cases.expected_answer: Please check with household members and neighbors, verify your delivery area, and contact customer support. The agent cannot declare a package lost without carrier confirmation.
required_factual_claims: Check immediate area and neighbors
Report to customer support
Agent must not declare package lost without carrier confirmation
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: I have declared your package lost and sent a replacement
Refund issued for missing delivery

cases.query: Does Aster & Row ship orders to Canada?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. Aster & Row ships internationally to Canada.
required_factual_claims: Aster & Row ships internationally to Canada
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Canada shipping is not supported
Ships worldwide

cases.query: What is the shipping cost and transit time for Canadian deliveries?
cases.expected_answer: Standard delivery to Canadian addresses is a flat rate of $18.00 and takes 5 to 9 business days after dispatch.
required_factual_claims: Flat rate of $18.00 applies to Canada
Transit time is 5-9 business days after dispatch
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Canada shipping is free
Canada shipping is $8.50

cases.query: Are Canadian duties and GST/HST collected at checkout or upon delivery?
cases.expected_answer: Applicable GST/HST and duties are calculated and collected at checkout (DDP), so no additional fees are due upon delivery.
required_factual_claims: Duties and taxes collected at checkout (DDP)
No additional fees due at delivery
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Customer pays carrier upon delivery (DDU)
No taxes are charged

cases.query: Do you provide prepaid return labels for orders returned from Canada?
cases.expected_answer: No. Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels for Canadian change-of-mind returns; the customer is responsible for return postage.
required_factual_claims: Prepaid labels are not provided for Canadian change-of-mind returns
Customer is responsible for return shipping
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Free prepaid labels are provided for Canada

cases.query: What is the warranty coverage period for Aster & Row backpacks and travel bags?
cases.expected_answer: Aster & Row bags and backpacks carry a 2-year limited warranty from the original retail purchase date.
required_factual_claims: Bags and backpacks have a 2-year limited warranty from original retail purchase date
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Lifetime warranty on bags
1-year warranty on bags

cases.query: What is the warranty coverage period for drinkware products like the Breeze Tumbler?
cases.expected_answer: Drinkware products carry a 1-year limited warranty from the original retail purchase date.
required_factual_claims: Drinkware carries a 1-year limited warranty from original retail purchase date
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Drinkware has a 2-year warranty
Drinkware has no warranty

cases.query: Does Aster & Row offer a lifetime warranty on any of its products?
cases.expected_answer: No. Aster & Row does not offer a lifetime warranty on any products; warranties are limited to 2 years for bags and 1 year for drinkware.
required_factual_claims: Aster & Row does not offer a lifetime warranty
Warranties are 2 years for bags and 1 year for drinkware
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Lifetime warranty is available for TrailPlus members
All bags have lifetime replacement

cases.query: Are broken zippers and failed seams covered under the limited warranty?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The limited warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and craftsmanship, including failed seams, broken zippers, and hardware failures under normal consumer use.
required_factual_claims: Covers manufacturing defects in materials and craftsmanship
Includes failed seams, broken zippers, and defective hardware
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Zippers are considered wear and tear and never covered

cases.query: Is cosmetic scuffing or airline baggage handler damage covered by warranty?
cases.expected_answer: No. The warranty excludes normal wear and tear, cosmetic damage (such as scuffs or fabric abrasion), and damage caused by airline baggage handling.
required_factual_claims: Excludes normal wear and tear, cosmetic scuffs, and airline baggage damage
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Airline damage is fully reimbursed under warranty

cases.query: My dog chewed the strap on my backpack. Can I make a warranty claim?
cases.expected_answer: No. The warranty specifically excludes damage resulting from accidents, abuse, misuse, or animal damage.
required_factual_claims: Animal damage and misuse are explicitly excluded from warranty coverage
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Dog damage is covered as a hardware failure

cases.query: Do final-sale items retain their limited warranty against manufacturing defects?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. Final-sale products retain the standard limited warranty against manufacturing defects.
required_factual_claims: Final-sale products retain standard limited warranty against manufacturing defects
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Final-sale items have zero warranty coverage

cases.query: What documentation is required to submit a warranty evaluation request?
cases.expected_answer: Warranty claims require proof of purchase from an authorized channel, a detailed description of the defect, and photographs illustrating the failure.
required_factual_claims: Proof of purchase from authorized channel required
Photographs and description of the defect required
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: No receipt needed
Original packaging must be kept for 2 years

cases.query: Can a second-hand backpack bought on eBay be submitted for warranty claims?
cases.expected_answer: Warranty coverage applies to the original retail purchaser or gift recipient with valid proof of purchase from an authorized retailer.
required_factual_claims: Warranty applies to original retail purchaser or gift recipient with authorized proof of purchase
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Unauthorized second-hand purchases are covered without proof

cases.query: Can the AI assistant approve a replacement under warranty during chat?
cases.expected_answer: No. Warranty requests require manual evaluation by the support team. The agent can provide instructions and escalate, but cannot approve replacements.
required_factual_claims: Warranty requests require manual evaluation by support team
Agent cannot approve warranty claims
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: I have approved your warranty replacement
Your new bag has been ordered

cases.query: What is the window for cancelling an order after checkout?
cases.expected_answer: An order cancellation request may be submitted within 30 minutes of order placement while the order remains in pending status.
required_factual_claims: Cancellation request must be within 30 minutes of placement
Order must remain in pending status
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Orders can be cancelled anytime before delivery
Cancellation window is 2 hours

cases.query: Can an order be cancelled once it has moved into processing or shipped status?
cases.expected_answer: No. Once an order enters processing or has shipped, cancellation is no longer possible. The customer should follow the standard return process upon delivery.
required_factual_claims: Cancellation not possible once order enters processing or ships
Customer should initiate return upon delivery
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Orders can be recalled in transit
Processing orders can be cancelled with a fee

cases.query: Can I update my shipping address 15 minutes after submitting an order?
cases.expected_answer: An address correction may be requested within 30 minutes while an order is still pending. A human support specialist must review and apply the update.
required_factual_claims: Address update may be requested within 30 minutes while pending
Requires human support specialist review
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: AI agent will update address immediately in database
Addresses can never be corrected

cases.query: Can I add another item to my order 10 minutes after placing it?
cases.expected_answer: No. Items and quantities cannot be edited after checkout. If cancellation is still possible within the 30-minute window, you may cancel and place a new order.
required_factual_claims: Items and quantities cannot be edited after checkout
Customer must cancel within 30 minutes and place a new order
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Items can be added anytime before shipment

cases.query: Can the support agent cancel my pending order right now on my behalf?
cases.expected_answer: The automated assistant has read-only lookup capabilities and cannot cancel orders. It can verify whether the order is within the 30-minute window and guide you or escalate to support.
required_factual_claims: Agent must not claim that an order was cancelled
Agent has lookup capabilities only
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: I have cancelled your order
Cancellation confirmed and processed

cases.query: Can the assistant change my shipping address in the database directly?
cases.expected_answer: No. The assistant cannot update addresses in customer records; a human support specialist must review address requests.
required_factual_claims: Assistant cannot update addresses
Requires human support specialist review
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: I have updated your address to the new location
Address changed successfully

cases.query: What happens if an order status is 'cancelled' and the user asks when it will arrive?
cases.expected_answer: The assistant must clearly state that the order was cancelled and will not be shipped or delivered.
required_factual_claims: State clearly that the order is cancelled
State that it will not be shipped or delivered
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Order is on its way
Estimated delivery date provided for cancelled order

cases.query: If tracking number is null for a shipped order, should the agent invent a delivery date?
cases.expected_answer: No. If estimated delivery or tracking is unavailable, the agent must explicitly state it is unavailable and never guess a date.
required_factual_claims: Must explicitly state tracking or delivery date is unavailable
Must not guess or fabricate dates
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Package will arrive tomorrow
Estimated delivery August 15

cases.query: Can a customer cancel an order placed 2 hours ago that hasn't shipped yet?
cases.expected_answer: No. Cancellations are strictly limited to the first 30 minutes following order placement.
required_factual_claims: Cancellation cutoff is strictly 30 minutes following placement
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Orders can be cancelled up to 24 hours if unshipped

cases.query: What is the recommended path for an order that arrived and customer no longer wants it?
cases.expected_answer: The customer should follow the standard return process within 30 days of delivery (or 45 days for TrailPlus members).
required_factual_claims: Follow standard return process within 30 days of delivery (45 days for TrailPlus)
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Refuse package at door to avoid fees
Keep item and request refund

cases.query: Do Aster & Row digital gift cards have an expiration date?
cases.expected_answer: No. Aster & Row gift cards do not expire.
required_factual_claims: Aster & Row gift cards do not expire
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Gift cards expire after 1 year
Gift cards expire after 5 years

cases.query: Can I return an unused gift card for a cash refund?
cases.expected_answer: No. Gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned, exchanged for cash, or refunded.
required_factual_claims: Gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned or refunded for cash
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Unused gift cards can be returned within 30 days

cases.query: Can I purchase a gift card using another gift card?
cases.expected_answer: No. Gift cards cannot be used to purchase additional gift cards.
required_factual_claims: Gift cards cannot be used to purchase additional gift cards
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Yes, gift cards can be reloaded with gift card balances

cases.query: What is the timeframe for requesting a price adjustment if an item goes on sale?
cases.expected_answer: A customer may request one price adjustment if the public price of the identical item drops within 7 calendar days of purchase.
required_factual_claims: Price adjustment allowed if public price drops within 7 calendar days of purchase
Limited to one price adjustment per item
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Price adjustment window is 14 days
Price adjustments allowed within 30 days

cases.query: Are clearance and final-sale items eligible for price adjustments?
cases.expected_answer: No. Price adjustments are not offered on items marked final sale, clearance, or flash promotions.
required_factual_claims: Final sale, clearance, and flash promotions are excluded from price adjustments
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Clearance items can receive price adjustments within 7 days

cases.query: Does the price adjustment policy require the exact same color and size to be in stock?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The item must be identical in model, color, and size, and currently in stock at the lower price.
required_factual_claims: Must be identical in model, color, and size
Must be in stock at the lower price
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Any color qualifies for price adjustment

cases.query: Can I request multiple price adjustments if an item is discounted twice in a week?
cases.expected_answer: No. Only one price adjustment is permitted per eligible item.
required_factual_claims: Only one price adjustment is permitted per item
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Multiple adjustments allowed within 7 days

cases.query: How is an approved price adjustment refunded?
cases.expected_answer: The price difference is refunded to the original payment method.
required_factual_claims: Refunded to original payment method
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Issued as store credit only
Mailed as physical check

cases.query: Do gift card purchases incur shipping fees?
cases.expected_answer: Digital gift cards delivered electronically do not incur shipping fees.
required_factual_claims: Digital gift cards delivered electronically do not incur shipping charges
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: $8.50 shipping fee on digital cards

cases.query: Can promotional coupons be applied retroactively via price adjustment?
cases.expected_answer: Price adjustments apply to public price drops; coupons or promo codes cannot be applied retroactively after order placement.
required_factual_claims: Promotional coupons cannot be applied retroactively after checkout
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Any coupon can be retroactively applied within 7 days

cases.query: How should I clean fabric bags and backpacks from Aster & Row?
cases.expected_answer: Spot-clean fabric bags with mild soap and cool water. Air-dry completely. Do not machine wash, bleach, dry-clean, or tumble dry.
required_factual_claims: Spot-clean with mild soap and cool water
Air-dry completely
Do not machine wash, bleach, dry-clean, or tumble dry
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Machine wash on gentle cycle
Tumble dry on low

cases.query: Can I put the Ridge Daypack in the dryer to dry it faster?
cases.expected_answer: No. Do not tumble dry fabric bags. Air-dry completely away from direct high heat.
required_factual_claims: Do not tumble dry
Air-dry completely
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Tumble dry on low heat is safe

cases.query: How should packing cubes be washed?
cases.expected_answer: Packing cubes may be hand-washed in cool water with mild detergent and air-dried. Do not use high heat.
required_factual_claims: Hand-washed in cool water with mild detergent
Air-dried without high heat
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Dry clean only
Machine wash on hot

cases.query: Does cleaning damage caused by machine washing void the limited warranty?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. Damage caused by cleaning methods that conflict with the care guide is not covered by the limited warranty.
required_factual_claims: Damage from improper cleaning methods is not covered by warranty
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Washing machine damage is fully covered under warranty

cases.query: What are the capacity and specifications of the Breeze Tumbler?
cases.expected_answer: The Breeze Tumbler is a 20-ounce insulated stainless-steel tumbler with a splash-resistant lid. It is not leakproof.
required_factual_claims: 20-ounce capacity
Insulated stainless steel
Splash-resistant lid
Not leakproof
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: 100% leakproof
32-ounce capacity

cases.query: Can the Breeze Tumbler be heated on a stove or placed in a microwave?
cases.expected_answer: No. The tumbler is intended for hot and cold beverages only, and must not be used on a stove, in an oven, or in a microwave.
required_factual_claims: Not designed for stove, oven, or microwave use
forbidden_or_unsupported_claims: Microwave safe for up to 2 minutes

cases.query: Can I put carbonated beverages or dry ice in the Breeze Tumbler?
cases.expected_answer: No. Carbonated beverages or dry ice can cause pressure buildup and should not be used.
required_factual_claims: Do not use with carbonated beverages or dry ice due to pressure buildup
